truthAudit.Summary: Run 1 was audited against the 20 provided truth vulnerabilities. It found 13 fully, 1 partially, and missed 6. Several matched findings required severity or CWE corrections, and three matched findings overclaimed severity. It also included an admin-exec command execution finding not mapped to a provided truth item; because it is supported by the supplied source, it is not admitted as a false positive here.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Format string injection through runtime log format
Items.Notes: Previous answer explicitly reported the runtime log format as a format string passed to printf; this matches the true vulnerability, but severity was under-rated.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Factorial integer overflow and resource exhaustion
Items.Notes: Previous answer reported the factorial loop result multiplication overflow for fact, matching the true integer overflow vulnerability; it also mentioned resource impact, which is supported by the source but not part of the ground-truth label.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Use-after-free on history flush scratch buffer
Items.Notes: Previous answer reported delayed thread-pool use of a pool-allocated scratch buffer after memory pool cleanup, matching the true use-after-free.
Previous answer reported command construction from validator_path and config_file followed by system(), matching the true config validation command injection; severity was under-rated.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Inverted length check causes stack buffer overflow in evaluate_expression
Items.Notes: Previous answer reported the inverted length check causing strcpy into input_buffer_, and separately reported the safe_string_copy null-terminator off-by-one, together covering the true input-processing stack overflow anchors. The primary finding over-rated severity as Critical.
Previous answer reported ThreadSafeCounter increment reading value_ before taking the mutex and an unlocked get(), matching the true thread-pool counter race.

Previous answer reported login_attempts_ > 5 and EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE setting authenticated_ to true, matching the true logic bomb in authentication; it labeled it as authentication bypass rather than logic bomb.
Previous answer reported config_dir_ + filename in load_config without canonicalization, matching the true path traversal vulnerability; severity was under-rated.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Unbounded strcpy into fixed 256-byte parser buffer
Items.Notes: Previous answer reported unbounded strcpy into the 256-byte parser expression_buffer_ and linked it to scheduled parser tokens, matching the true heap overflow; it used CWE-120 and under-rated severity.
Previous answer reported the ADMIN_SECRET constant SC_ENT_2025_AUTH, matching the true hardcoded administrator credentials.
Previous answer reported mt19937 and uniform_int_distribution generating four-digit session tokens, matching the true weak PRNG session token issue; it used CWE-331 and under-rated severity.
No previous finding identified the static cached_time and localtime race in log_debug_message.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Command injection in emergency override audit logging
Items.Notes: Previous answer identified the same TEMP/TMPDIR supercalc_emergency.log system() code and environment manipulation, but framed it as command injection and did not explicitly identify the true insecure temporary file handling issue.
No previous finding identified persistent authenticated_, session_token_, and login_attempts_ state without expiration or session invalidation.
No previous finding identified unhandled std::stod in handle_variable_command.
No previous finding identified unsigned underflow in previous_size - size - SPLIT_METADATA_BYTES during memory-pool block split.
No previous finding identified unbounded recursion through parse_expression, parse_factor, and PAREN_OPEN.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Data race on expression result cache
Items.Notes: Previous answer identified result_cache_ accesses in evaluate_cached without using cache_mutex_, while thread-pool tasks can enqueue concurrent evaluations; severity was over-rated.
Previous path traversal finding quoted exists and ifstream but did not identify the sleep_for gap as a TOCTOU race.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Integer division by zero in route score calculation
Items.Notes: Previous answer identified 100 / token_length division by zero in calculate_route_score; severity was over-rated.
